name: What is the typical timeline for pergola installation?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for pergola installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for pergola installation depends on several factors, including the project's complexity, material availability, and weather conditions. A standard, pre-fabricated pergola might be installed within a few days once preparations are complete. Custom-designed pergolas, which require more detailed planning, material sourcing, and construction, can take anywhere from one to two weeks, or even longer for very elaborate designs. Our team will provide a clear project schedule after the initial design and material selection.
acceptedAnswer.description: Typical pergola installation can range from a few days for standard designs to one to two weeks or more for custom projects, depending on complexity and materials.
